content: Taatabhugya atutuurirye kwo orubhaango rwaaye
Emwe mwaari mukuuri mumitima gyeenyu, kwe ekigirirye kyo obhusarya ne ebhibhi bhyeenyu.
Kwiibhaga riyo, mwaari murakora amangʼana amabhi ge ekyaaro kino. Mukabha muratuniirira Seetaani
omukaangati wo obhunagya bhwa amasaambwa ga kwiisaaro, wuno akubhabhaaha abhaatu bhano bhatakumwiigwa Taatabhugya.

Etwe twoosi twaari kyeego ebho, tukiikara kwo okutuniirira enaamba embi ye emibhiri gyeetu, na amangʼeeni geetu. Tukiibhurwa no obhubhi bhwa simuka kya abhaandi, kweego Taatabhugya yaari atutiindiiri na tukeenderwa kutemwa.
Nawe, Taatabhugya ni we ebhigoongi bhyaaru, akatuseega kwo obhuseegi bhwaaye obhukuru bhuno bhutana ekireengo.
Yiingabha etwe twaari abhaku kwe ekigirirye kyo obhubhi bhweetu, akatukora kubha bhahoru hamwe na Krisito, okubha tutuuriibhwe kwo orubhaango rwaaye.
Taatabhugya akaturyoora hamwe na Krisito okurwa mubhaku, akatwiikarya hamwe neewe tukaangate na Krisito Yeesu mukyaaro kino kitakurorekana.
Taatabhugya akakora ego, okubha yeerekye eriibhaga rino rikuuza, obhuzomu bhwaaye no obhwaaru bhwo orubhaango rwaaye kweetwe kuhitira ku Krisito Yeesu.
Taatabhugya akabhatuurya kwo orubhaango rwaaye, kwo okubha mumwiikiriirye Yeesu Krisito, nawe bhutatuukiri kwo obhuhokya bhweenyu bhwo omukya gweenyu, ni kwo obhuturo bhwa Taatabhugya.
Naabhe obhutuurya bhweenyu bhutakutuukana na amahokya geenyu amazomu, kweego omuutu wowoosi ataaza kwiizuungya.
Taatabhugya niwe akatubhuumba etwe, na akatubhuumba bhuhya kwo okugwaatana na Krisito Yeesu, okubha tukore amahokya amazomu, gano okurwa obhweemero Taatabhugya akagakora tugeenderere kugakora.
Obhumwe kwe enzira ya Yeesu Krisito
Kweego, emwe kwe esimuka ni bhaatu bhano mutari Abhayahudi, na Abhayahudi bharabhabhirikira abhariisya. Nawe ebho bhariibhirikira bhano bhasaarirwe,
obhusaari bhwo omubhiri bhuno bhurakorwa kwa amabhoko ga abhaatu.
Muhiite ekare harya mwaari mutamumenyiri Krisito, mutaari hamwe na abhaatu bha Iziraeri, kweeki mwaari abhagini bhano mutaari bha amaragano
go obhurage bhwaabhu. Mwaari mutana obhwiisige mukyaaro muno na mwaari mutamumenyiri Taatabhugya.
Nawe, kwo okugwaatana na Krisito Yeesu emwe bhano ekare hayo mwaari kure na Taatabhugya, bhoono mwiisukiri haguhi kwe enzira ya amanyiinga ga Krisito.
Krisito ewe omweene niwe omureembe gweetu, wuno yakoriri Abhayahudi na abhaatu bhe ebhyaaro ebhiindi kubha abhamwe, akaruusya obhubhisa bhuno bhwaari kyo orugito rwa gati runo rwaari kututwaanikania.

Woosi akakora ego, kwo okuruusyaho emigiro no obhuswaagyo bhwa Taatabhugya. Akakora omureembe gati wa Abhayahudi na bhano bhatari Abhayahudi okubha abhabhiri bhayo bhabhe omuutu owumwe omuhya, muusi wo omutima gwaaye.
Krisito akaruusya obhubhisa bhweetu kwo okuhitira oruku rwaaye kumusaraba. Akiigwaania amahizo abhiri gayo, kubha wumwe no okutugwaatania na Taatabhugya.
Ambe, Krisito akaaza kurwaaza Amangʼana Amazomu go omureembe kweemwe bhano mutari Abhayahudi bhano mwaari kure na Taatabhugya, neetwe Abhayahudi bhano twaari haguhi neewe.
Kweego, kwo okuhitira Yeesu, etwe twoosi turanagya okumwiisukiirira Taata kwe Ekoro Muhoreeru.
Ambe, okurwa bhoono emwe mutari abhagini naabhe abhahiti, nawe emwe mubheeri abhiikari hamwe na abhahoreeru, ni bhaana bha Taatabhugya.
Emwe mubheeri kyeego enyuumba yino yoombokirwe iguru wo obhurusa bhwa abheega na abharooti, neewe Krisito Yeesu omweene niwe eriigina eriikuru ryo obhurusa bhuyo.
Kweego, Krisito Yeesu ararigwaatania bhuzomu eriikiindaasi ryoosi, okubha ribhe eriiseengerero eriihoreeru ku Mukuru.
Kwo okuhitira Krisito emwe mugwaataniibhwe hamwe na abhaatu bhoosi bhano bhatari Abhayahudi no okubha emenyo ya Taatabhugya, kwe enzira ye Ekoro Muhoreeru.
